what: Freeport-McMoRan mines copper. Its largest assets are the Grasberg mine in Indonesia, one of the biggest copper and gold deposits in the world, and copper mines in Arizona, New Mexico and South America.
customers: Copper smelters, refiners and metal traders; gold is sold into bullion markets.
money: mining, milling and smelting at North American, South American and Indonesian operations
gold from Grasberg and molybdenum from US mines
moat: Ore bodies of a scale and grade that cannot be replaced: Grasberg in particular has no close equivalent anywhere.
risks: Profit moves directly with the copper price
Indonesian government ownership and export rules affect Grasberg
An incident at Grasberg disrupted production and showed the concentration risk
Mining cost inflation has reduced margins across the industry
opportunities: Copper demand is rising with grids, data centres and electric vehicles while new supply is scarce
Leaching technology is recovering extra copper from existing waste at low cost
Gold production alongside copper adds revenue when gold prices are high
watch: Copper production volumes and unit net cash costs, plus the restart schedule at Grasberg.
